name: sparx — Home Goods (Modern Design)
tagline: A crisp, modern storefront for a design-led homeware brand.
description: A complete, working shop for a design-led homeware brand: a real catalogue of a modern arc floor lamp, a sculptural vase, a graphic wool-blend rug, a lacquer tray, a modular steel-and-oak shelf, geometric cushions, a glass carafe set and a minimalist wall clock, with categories, collections, a bespoke PDP and a full merchandised home page. Crisp, architectural theme — a cool near-white ground, a near-black primary and an ochre accent. Shipped as Form & Field.
